title: Book 2, Aphorisms 21–37
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Book 2, Aphorisms 21–37, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 159–212. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: The helps to induction that follow the first vintage, beginning with the prerogative instances. These first fifteen kinds aid the understanding: solitary, migrating, conspicuous, clandestine, constitutive, similar, singular, deviating and bordering instances, instances of power, accompanying and hostile, subjunctive and allied instances, and the instances of the cross and of divorce.
